description: Plan: novel quality & reader experience enhancement — 8 tasks in 3 waves from brainstorm

tasks.title: Extend WritingCraftDimension with hook & cliffhanger types
tasks.description: Add 'hook' and 'cliffhanger' to WritingCraftDimension enum. Create prompt templates for chapter opening (first 200 chars) and ending (last 200 chars) scoring. Hook dimensions: conflict_hint, info_gap, sensory_impact, pacing_entry. Cliffhanger dimensions: unresolved_questions, emotional_peak, twist_impact, anticipation.

tasks.title: Implement hook & cliffhanger scoring service
tasks.description: Create scoring logic that extracts chapter boundaries, runs LLM analysis per dimension, returns scores 0-100. Integrate with existing WritingCraftResult structure. Add caching via intelligenceService.

tasks.title: Add character voice fingerprint extraction
tasks.description: Extend consistencyEngine to extract all dialogue per character, build voice fingerprint (sentence_length_preference, catchphrases, formality_level, emotional_expression_tendency, rhetorical_habits). Store in StoryBible character entries.

tasks.title: Add voice consistency check to dialogue analysis
tasks.description: Implement real-time dialogue consistency check against stored voice fingerprints. Flag when dialogue deviates from character's established speech patterns. Show warnings in editor via TipTap extension.

tasks.title: Build emotional arc timeline component
tasks.description: Create EmotionalArcChart component for WritingDashboard. Aggregate emotion dimension scores across chapters, render as interactive timeline. Highlight emotional peaks/valleys, detect 'tension deserts' (N+ chapters without emotional movement). Compare against classic narrative curves.

tasks.title: Implement Show vs Tell analysis
tasks.description: Extend styleProfile with showTellRatio and sensoryCoverage metrics. Analyze sensory description density (5 senses), abstract vs concrete statement ratio, emotional expression method (direct statement vs behavioral demonstration). Generate paragraph-level heat map data.

tasks.title: Add reader immersion engine foundation
tasks.description: Create reader_state model with curiosity, emotional_investment, cognitive_load, suspense_tension, immersion metrics. Build cross-chapter tracking infrastructure. Generate 'reader dropout risk' scores per chapter.

tasks.title: Add pacing navigator with prescription capability
tasks.description: Extend intelligence pacing module with forward-looking analysis. Generate 'pacing prescriptions' — recommend where to add climax/turning_point/breathing_room. Integrate with ForeshadowingTracker to recommend harvest timing.

waves.description: P0 core: hook/cliffhanger scoring + voice fingerprint extraction
P0 completion + P1: voice consistency UI + emotional arc + show/tell
P2 advanced: reader immersion + pacing navigator
